topic.angle: Printing scaled up book production within 60 years

body.question: Gutenberg's press arrived around 1440. By 1500, about how many copies had printing presses across Western Europe produced?
body.reveal: Over 20 million copies by 1500, and an estimated 150-200 million by 1600. Cheaper printed texts helped raise adult literacy, and books increasingly appeared in everyday languages instead of Latin.

probes.question: As printing spread, books increasingly appeared in which kind of language?
True or false: the printing press was invented by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440.

claims.claim: Gutenberg's press arrived around 1440; invented by Gutenberg c.1440 (question, p2)
By 1500 presses in Western Europe produced over 20 million copies (answer 20)
claims.quote: By 1500, printing presses throughout Western Europe had produced over 20 million copies
Their output grew to an estimated 150-200 million copies by 1600

claims.claim: Cheaper printed texts helped raise adult literacy
claims.quote: The cost of printed texts declined and their availability increased, facilitating higher adult literacy rates across Europe

claims.claim: Books increasingly appeared in everyday languages instead of Latin (p1)
claims.quote: Books increasingly appeared in vernacular languages rather than Latin
